title: Approximating k-Center via Farthest-First on $δ$-Covers
summary: The farthest-first traversal of Gonzalez is a classical $2$-approximation algorithm for solving the $k$-center problem, but its sequential nature makes it difficult to scale to very large datasets. In this work we study the effect of running farthest-first on a $δ$-cover of the dataset rather than on the full set of points. A $δ$-cover provides a compact summary of the data in which every point lies within distance $δ$ of some selected center.
